heading: RANGE
excerpt: RANGE (Rethinking Assumptions in a New Geostrategic Environment) is a crowdsourced forecasting program focused on geopolitics and the transatlantic relationship.
description: RANGE (Rethinking Assumptions in a New Geostrategic Environment) is a crowdsourced forecasting platform that leverages collective intelligence to explore geopolitical developments and trends shaping the transatlantic relationship and beyond. By bringing together diverse perspectives, RANGE helps identify emerging challenges, test assumptions, and better understand an uncertain global environment.
